name: Pikmin Bloom Walking Adventure
description:
Pikmin Bloom offers a fun way to earn rewards for going outside and exploring with friends! With the brand-new Weekly Challenges feature, you can team up with others, no matter how far away they might be, and work towards a shared steps goal!

__
COLLECT over 150 types of unique Decor Pikmin! Some wear fishing lures, some don hamburger buns, and others flaunt paper airplanes, just to name a few.

EXPLORE your neighborhood to add more Pikmin to your squad! The more you walk, the more seedlings and fruit you’ll find.

TEAM UP with friends to take down mushrooms and earn rewards! Select a dream team of Pikmin to increase your score and nab rarer fruit types!

DECORATE the world with beautiful flowers everywhere you go! Watch the map fill up with colorful blossoms, planted by you and by other players nearby!

Head outside, explore your neighborhood, and make the world bloom!
_______________

name: PushClock - Loud Alarm Clock
description:
PushClock is the alarm clock that won't let you off easy.

Set your alarm. Pick your mission. When it goes off, you have to actually do something to make it stop. Ignore it and it comes right back.

No snooze. No swipe-and-back-to-sleep. Just you and the proof you're up.

25+ WAYS TO WAKE UP

Move (the camera counts your reps automatically)
· Push-ups, squats, sit-ups, jumping jacks, high knees
· Plank, squat hold, dance
· Steps and shake, no camera needed

Prove it (AI checks the photo)
· Make your bed
· Object hunt: find something in your house
· Touch grass: actually go outside
· Pet hunt, sky photo, or set your own custom target

Think
· Math problems, memory game
· Guess the flag, language quiz
· Bible verse, draw a picture

For fun
· The 67, tongue twisters, recreate a meme

STACK THEM
Put more than one mission on a single alarm. 10 push-ups, then a math problem, then a photo of your made bed. You decide how hard your morning is.

IT DOESN'T GIVE UP
Silence it, mute it, swipe it away. It rings again seconds later, and it keeps coming back until the mission is done. That's the whole point.

STILL NOT SURE YOU'RE UP?
Turn on Wake-up Check and PushClock rings again a few minutes after your mission. Type the code to prove you didn't crawl back into bed.

LOCK YOUR PHONE UNTIL YOU'RE UP
Turn on app blocking and your distracting apps stay shut from bedtime until you finish your mission. No doomscrolling in bed.

BUILD THE STREAK
Every morning you win counts. Track your streak
